known_source_result.model: HAI 23.05 locally fitted five-second multivariate temporal ridge
known_source_result.score: mean top-20 standardized prediction residual with 120-second EWMA

fit_sampling: Every fifth eligible transition from each normal fit trace. Source and target releases are fitted separately with identical sampling and hyperparameters.

transition_evaluation.target: next normalized vector over every finite, non-label signal in the release-specific schema
transition_evaluation.metric: geometric mean of per-signal normalized MAE at H=1, H=3 and H=5
transition_evaluation.per_proxy_action_mean_baseline: mean signal delta for idle, material-control-change and stop proxy actions fitted on the release's normal fit traces
transition_evaluation.material_change: mean absolute normalized control-signal delta above the normal-fit 90th percentile
transition_evaluation.stop: emergency, trip or on/off transition where the documented signals are available
transition_evaluation.anti_collapse: variance of predicted deltas divided by variance of observed deltas

selection: Choose the source candidate with highest 52-window recall among candidates passing every source gate and both releases' normal false-alert ceiling. Apply the identical algorithmic configuration to the already fitted target-domain checkpoint, then commit target weights, scaling, residual scaling and numeric threshold before final download.
claim_boundary: Full-signal transition error is a cross-release predictor metric and is not the eight-dimensional Ferrum-state metric reported in v1. Both must be named explicitly and never compared as if they used the same target space.
